title: [spec-gap][R-12-008] Messaging custody send path absent: S+C flags, CON, /msg/custody advertisement, push delivery
description: spec/12-apps.md:98-107 (18.1.2) + 18.1.4: unicast messages MUST default to custody transfer — sender sets DTN S and C flags and sends via CoAP CON; broadcast uses datagram. No C flag constant exists in any stack (only receive-side DTN_FLAG_S=0x80: dtn_option.py:22, router.c:265); no CON/datagram selection; no /msg/custody custody-transfer handshake (capability advertised as rt='msg.store' at /msg/store, msg_store.py:10-11 — spec says </msg/custody>;rt='msg.custody'); custodian delivery is pull-drain only, no push with wait-for-ACK/retain-until-TTL/delete-on-success (msg_store.py:199-224); 5.03 back-pressure is bare (no Max-Age + {reason,available,retry_after} body); store POST returns 2.04 not 2.01. Storage-limit table and fair-share eviction DO conform (msg_store.py:76-142, 13 tests). Custody remains best effort per decision custody-best-effort — bead asks for conformance to the §18.1.4 MUST table, not a new eviction/TTL/retry policy. Placement: messaging send path + msg_store.py rename/response-shape + C/Rust equivalents.
